about_the_game:
• The more you care, the more momos you collect!

With 500 designs prepared for the full game, you’ll collect a cluster of soggy, circular companions! Then select up to three of your latest favorites to float around in your bowl. You’ll find many momos with their own unique shapes, sounds, and behaviors!

  • Gameplay that’s reward-focused and comfort-centered.

Marimomo aspires to reward players without punishment, and its goal is to share a cozy and comforting experience. Get rewarded with your pick of decor items, bowl styles, cozy wallpapers, and more momos. There’s nothing to lose, but there’s a copious amount of companions to encounter!

  • Help, comfort, and nurture your momos in wholesome activities.

Cozy, undemanding minigames will help your momos feel happy and content, but you won’t be penalized if you miss out on their care! By interacting with them, your momos will thank you in Bubble Coins. Save up to decorate your homely habitat, or spend them on the Momo Machine— where you can get even more buoyant buddies!

  • Enjoy immersive and satisfying interactions!

Marimomo’s game-feel is focused on tactile, responsive, and sensory play. Grab, wiggle, carry, twist, turn, toss, and more with in-game objects— including your own momos!

Care for your momos on your time, without worrying about pet death or other common virtual pet penalties. You can check in on them anytime that's most convenient for you, with no punishments for being too busy. No risk, no commitment— just you, your hydrated habitat, and your faithful floaty friends are ready for you!

This project is handmade by an independent, solo developer. During the early stages of development, any proposed designs, art direction, or concepts are yet to be finalized and could be subject to change.

short_description: Virtual pets, WITHOUT the responsibility. Care for cute marimo moss balls on your schedule, and never stress over keeping them alive! Find, collect, and nurture your Momos— all with unique designs, satisfying sounds, and surprising behaviors. There’s a multitude of moss to amass!
